purpose: Add bounded before/returned stage observation to the private prepared-example header, independently writable before ApplicationData; parent collector is a separate reviewed source change.

authorChecks.scope: Five portable source/format/model review designs only; no C++ compiler, Win32 IO, Windows process, native UI or concurrency execution.
groups: Exact Git/SHA/byte provenance and fifteen reversible unique source transforms
Original expression ownership, operation ordering, callback and geometry/protocol preservation
Actual fixed resolver/flags/schema agreement and every label's maximum-width JSON row
Portable cap, partial-write, failed-write and contention semantics with retained writer ownership
Source-level GetLastError, one-shot, nonblocking lock and secondary diagnostic ownership guards

independentReview.finalGate: Independently read the complete source/diff and found no blocker; returned-marker interpretation qualified below. Collector and native runtime are separate.
independentReview.root: Independently read all fifteen exact edits and reproduced the five-group, 517-assertion V8 harness; no blocking source defect found. Static/model review only.

interpretation.returnedMarkers: A returned marker proves control reached its inserted statement. Several follow the original success guard or Refuse; a missing returned marker does not prove the API never returned.
interpretation.constructorMarkers: Observer and Hook constructor body markers occur after member initialization. Hook body exit is not a winrt::make-return marker.
interpretation.windowScope: Only the first WindowMessage callback is observed. Its scope-exit marker labels the diagnostic destructor, not a success result or coverage of all callbacks.
interpretation.writerLoss: Try-lock contention records an observed-through-row boolean only. A cap row is evidence only if successfully written. Later loss is unknown; no finalized footer exists.
interpretation.paths: GetTempPathW depends on process environment; the parent and child may resolve different paths. A missing file never proves Configure was not entered.
interpretation.timing: Trace IO may perturb startup; no timestamps or elapsed/causal conclusion are emitted. Synchronous Win32 calls have no hard cancellation deadline.
interpretation.partial: Write error disables further writes and retains the owned handle; a partial trailing row may remain. Collector must retain exact bounded bytes and identify partial/invalid data.

unchanged.setEvaluation: Original caller expression and unspecified argument evaluation preserved; no extracted Properties/factory argument calls.
unchanged.app: All original Observer constructor/registration statements retain relative order, original callback/close/visual/request protocol unchanged apart from diagnostic scope.
unchanged.otherFiles: No shipping component, preparer, navigation behavior, launcher, host/security/permissions, workflow, dependencies, deadlines or acceptance predicates changed by this header-only candidate.

notExecuted: Native UI, drag, RTL, tooltip or full release acceptance
